title: Hillary's presidential run timed with the setting up of AATIP and the New York Times article

tellings.quote: Yeah. And uh if you look at the timing I I'll tell you it's probably no coincidence that when Hillary was running for president that that there's a correlation in timing with the standing up of ATIP and what led to the New York Times article

plain: The timing of Hillary Clinton's run for president, says a man named Jake Barber, lines up with the setting up of AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, and with what led to a New York Times article about it. Barber, who says he flew a helicopter to recover a UFO, tells Michels it is "probably no coincidence". If he is right, the opening up of the UFO subject between 2007 and 2017 was tied to politics at the top.
